body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.56 (naive sector base rate 0.55) that: KPIT Q4FY27 constant-currency revenue growth QoQ (company-reported) is >0%. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/IT_MIDCAPS_peer_comparison.md section 5 = AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5, unchanged): p0 = 0.55 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'revenue_growth', n=8); SAC +6.6 pts x weight 0.2 (N=5) -> p = 0.56. Evidence: Q1FY27: 'we will return to growth in H2 by Q4'; Q2FY27: 'we expect growth in that quarter' (no number). Q1FY27 -3.6% CC QoQ; Q2FY27 services flat, products +5% QoQ. Resolution: YES if KPIT reports Q4 FY27 (Jan-Mar 2027) sequential revenue growth in constant currency > 0.0%. If only USD growth is given, it is used; if neither, INR QoQ from screener. Source: KPIT Q4 FY27 press release / investor presentation / call (NSE). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.55 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'revenue_growth', n=8); SAC +6.6 pts x weight 0.2 (N=5) -> p = 0.56
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 3 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'revenue_growth' promises among the other IT mid-cap peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=8). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if KPIT reports Q4 FY27 (Jan-Mar 2027) sequential revenue growth in constant currency > 0.0%. If only USD growth is given, it is used; if neither, INR QoQ from screener.
data.resolution_source: KPIT Q4 FY27 press release / investor presentation / call (NSE)
